Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 32 now!
Synopsis :
Chandragupta outrageously looks for a clue to find out his mother's whereabouts in Lubdhak's house. He finds the belongings of a child of Pipliwan. He then decides to seek help from Mura to know about his mother. Meanwhile, Amatya Rakshas declares that the thief, who stole the diamond won't be forgiven. Mura suspects Chandragupta behind the robbery. So, when she tries to interrogate him, Chandragupta enquires her about the belongings found earlier. Mura fails to tell anything as he is summoned by Dhananand.
